## Boxplots CpG vs condition

```{r}
boxplot.single.cpg <- function(cpg, values, type, pheno.color.var, result.dir) {
  # Create result directory if it doesn't exist
  if (!dir.exists(result.dir)) {
    dir.create(result.dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Prepare data for the single CpG site
  plot.data <- data.frame(
    methylation = values[cpg, ],
    condition = pheno.color.var
  )
  
  # Define the desired order and colors
  condition_order <- c("controls_es", "cCOPD","StageIV_COPD", "SEO_COPD")
  color_palette <- c("controls_es" = "cadetblue", "cCOPD" = "pink","StageIV_COPD"="orange", "SEO_COPD" = "darkred")
  
  # Convert condition to factor with desired order
  plot.data$condition <- factor(plot.data$condition, levels = condition_order)
  
  # Create the boxplot
  box.plot <- ggplot(
    plot.data,
    aes(x = condition, y = methylation, fill = condition)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      alpha = 0.9,
      outlier.shape = NA,  # Hide outliers since we'll show all points
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      width = 0.6,
      lwd = 1.2,           # Make all boxplot lines thicker
      fatten = 2.5         # Specifically make the median line even thicker
    ) +
    geom_quasirandom( 
      aes(color = condition),
      dodge.width = 0.8,
      alpha = 0.9,
      size = 4,
      shape = 21,             # shape 21 = circle with fill and border
      color = "black",        # border (outline) color
      stroke = 1.2            # thickness of the outline
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Methylation Levels (", cpg, ")", sep = ""),
      x = "Sample type",
      y = paste0("methylation (", type, "-values)"),
      fill = "Condition"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_palette) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
      axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),  # show x-axis line
      axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),  # show y-axis line
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 18, angle = 90),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 18),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = "top",
      panel.grid = element_blank()   # Remove grid lines
    )

# Create filename
  filename <- file.path(result.dir, paste0("boxplot_COPD_all_state_", cpg, ".svg"))
  
  # Save the plot
  ggsave(
    filename = filename,
    plot = box.plot,
    device = "svg",
    width = 5,
    height = 7,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  return(box.plot)
}

# cg26036029- AGER
# cg21733531- ZNF727

```

```{r}
# Normalize counts for visualization
dge <- DGEList(counts = rna.expression.COPD.states)
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge, method = "TMM")
logcpm <- cpm(dge, log = TRUE, prior.count = 3)

# clean sample names in RNA mtx to match the names in methylation data
colnames(logcpm) <- colnames(logcpm) |>
  gsub("^X", "", x = _) |>
  gsub("\\.", "-", x = _)

# Prepare data for plotting
plot_data <- logcpm[rownames(logcpm) %in% ENS.geneID, ] %>%
              as.data.frame() %>%
              tibble::rownames_to_column("ENS.GeneID")%>%
              pivot_longer(-ENS.GeneID, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Expression")%>%
              left_join(
                pheno.data.RNA.SEO[, c("GenomeScan_ID_RNAseq", "SEO_COPD_Y_or_N")],
                by = c("Sample" = "GenomeScan_ID_RNAseq")
                )
head(plot_data)
```

```{r}
boxplot.single.gene <- function(gene, values, type, pheno.color.var, id.mapping.df, 
                               ensembl.id.col, symbol.col, result.dir) {
  
  # Create result directory if it doesn't exist
  if (!dir.exists(result.dir)) {
    dir.create(result.dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Create mapping from symbol to ENSEMBL ID
  mapping <- id.mapping.df[, c(ensembl.id.col, symbol.col)]
  colnames(mapping) <- c("ensembl", "symbol")
  
  # Find ENSEMBL ID for requested gene
  ensembl_id <- NULL
  gene_label <- NULL
  
  # Check if gene is already an ENSEMBL ID in the matrix
  if (gene %in% rownames(values)) {
    ensembl_id <- gene
    gene_label <- gene
  } 
  # Check if gene is a symbol that can be mapped
  else {
    matched <- mapping[mapping$symbol == gene & mapping$ensembl %in% rownames(values), ]
    if (nrow(matched) > 0) {
      ensembl_id <- matched$ensembl[1]
      gene_label <- gene
    } else {
      stop(paste("Gene not found or not mappable:", gene))
    }
  }
  
  # Prepare data for the single gene
  plot.data <- data.frame(
    expression = as.numeric(values[ensembl_id, ]),
    condition = pheno.color.var
  )
  
  # Create the boxplot
  box.plot <- ggplot(
    plot.data,
    aes(x = condition, y = expression, fill = condition)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      alpha = 0.9,
      outlier.shape = NA,  # Hide outliers since we'll show all points
      width = 0.6,
      lwd = 1.2,           # Make all boxplot lines thicker
      fatten = 2.5         # Specifically make the median line even thicker
    ) +
    geom_quasirandom( 
      aes(color = condition),
      dodge.width = 0.8,
      alpha = 0.9,
      size = 4,
      shape = 21,             # shape 21 = circle with fill and border
      color = "black",        # border (outline) color
      stroke = 1.2            # thickness of the outline
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Gene Expression for", gene_label),
      x = "Sample type",
      y = paste0("Gene Expression (", type, ")"),
      fill = "Condition"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("cadetblue", "darkred")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("cadetblue", "darkred")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),  # show x-axis line
      axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),  # show y-axis line
      legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = "top",
      panel.grid = element_blank()   # Remove grid lines
    )
  
  # Create filename
  filename <- file.path(result.dir, paste0("boxplot_gene_", gene_label, ".svg"))
  
  # Save the plot
  ggsave(
    filename = filename,
    plot = box.plot,
    device = "svg",
    width = 5,
    height = 7,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  return(box.plot)
}
```
